title: 01 ARRIVE
evidence:
Entrance signs; scanners or
app; checkout lanes.
back:
Check device readiness;
assign store assistance.
support:
Device support;
staff rota and instructions.
db:
Device ID; status;
shift and help cover.
recovery:
P Clear instructions;
staffed checkout available.

title: 02 FIND AND SELECT
evidence:
Products; shelf labels;
Tally where deployed.
customer:
Find and choose products;
ask about missing stock.
front:
Tally checks shelves where
used; staff answer stock queries.
back:
Review alert; check stock;
assign shelf replenishment.
support:
Inventory control;
alert queue and replenishment.
db:
SKU/barcode; shelf quantity;
alert and refill status.
recovery:
P Named alert owner;
confirm refill or explain shortage.

title: 03 SCAN AND REVIEW
evidence:
Barcode; basket display;
scanner or checkout terminal.
customer:
Scan&Go: scan in aisles.
Self-checkout: scan at till.
Cashier: hand over basket.
front:
Terminal shows scanned item;
cashier scans; attendant helps.
back:
Verify barcode, price and
promotions; correct item.
support:
Product catalogue;
price updates and basket system.
db:
Item; quantity; price;
promotion; basket total.
recovery:
P Check item; recover basket
where technically possible.

title: 04 PAY AND LEAVE
evidence:
Total; payment screen;
receipt; exit signs.
customer:
Check total; pay;
collect receipt and leave.
front:
Confirm payment; help with
declines or a stopped terminal.
support:
Payment gateway;
terminal and transaction support.
db:
Transaction ID; payment status;
itemised receipt.
recovery:
P Allocate attendant;
check status before retry.

title: 05 AFTERCARE
customer:
If needed, query a charge
or request a return.
front:
Hear complaint; explain
correction or return.
back:
Review receipt and item;
authorise remedy or escalate.
support:
Receipt lookup;
returns policy and case handling.
db:
Case ID; receipt reference;
reason; remedy and outcome.
recovery:
P Transfer receipt and case;
assign one case owner.
